run_sacred_experiment_greet: run the sacred experiment greet command to print a greeting message with a configurable name
run_sacred_experiment_shout: run the sacred experiment shout command to print a slang shout message
run_sacred_experiment_main: run the sacred experiment main command to see available command options
create_sacred_command: create a sacred experiment command using the ex.command decorator to add a CLI command
configure_sacred_experiment: configure a sacred experiment using the ex.config decorator to set default config values
